name: coop-haven
description: CoOp:Anything: every co-op mod for single-player games. Static site plus a Cloudflare Worker for votes.

scripts.dev: python tools/build_pages.py && wrangler d1 migrations apply coop-haven --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: python tools/build_pages.py && wrangler d1 migrations apply coop-haven --remote && wrangler deploy
